component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.documents.schema
component.documentation: The add-on's schemas and facets. A kit's document type is controlled by carrying the ControlledDocument facet, which brings the controlled_document schema, prefix docctl, the controlled_review schema, prefix docrev, the review cycles closed on the revision, and, since 0.3.0, the export_mark schema, prefix docmark, the revision's export-control mark. A kit's transmittal type carries Transmittal (transmittal, trm), its receipt type TransmittalReceipt (transmittal_receipt, trr), and its review cycle type ReviewCycle (review_cycle, rvw). ReviewComment (review_comment, rvwc) is given by the server to each of Nuxeo's own comments written in a review cycle, on the comment itself, so Nuxeo's Comment type is not changed.
